obligations.summary: The AI Office may take necessary actions to monitor effective implementation and compliance with this Regulation by providers of general-purpose AI models, including adherence to approved codes of practice.

Downstream providers lodging a complaint alleging an infringement must ensure the complaint is duly reasoned and includes at minimum: the point of contact of the general-purpose AI model provider concerned, a description of the relevant facts and provisions infringed, and any other relevant information.
